T: One bite. Make sure it's pie.
D: A princess hides from her jealous stepmother in a cottage with seven dwarfs.
P: Serve dessert when Snow White bakes her pie for Grumpy.
S: the dwarfs digging diamonds in the mine
Cubes of cheddar, gouda and brie threaded onto toothpicks with red and green grapes, piled on a dark board so they glitter like gems.
Cottage garden veg with dill yoghurt dip
the little cottage in the woods

Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and snow peas standing in little jars around a cool dip of Greek yoghurt, dill, lemon and garlic. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp chopped dill, the zest and juice of half a lemon, 1 small crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp olive oil and salt, then chill. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots, leaving a little green on top. Halve 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 cucumber into sticks and string 150g snow peas. Stand the vegetables upright in small jars around the bowl of dip.
the forest animals that help Snow White clean the cottage

Walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds tossed with honey, chopped rosemary and salt, roasted at 170C for 15 minutes, cooled and broken into clusters. Toss 100g each of walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds with 3 tbsp honey, a spoon of chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely, then break into clusters for little hands.
M: supper for seven hungry dwarfs home from the mine
Chicken, leek and potato soup simmered with thyme, finished with cream, served with crusty bread.
Cottage herb roast chicken and veg
the dwarfs' cottage in the woods

Whole chicken roasted with lemon and herbs on a bed of potatoes and carrots that soak up the juices, carved at a long wooden table. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt, thyme and rosemary and put half a lemon inside. Toss 1kg potato chunks and 500g carrots with oil and salt in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes until the juices run clear and the vegetables are golden. Rest 10 minutes, carve and spoon the pan juices over everything.
W: the gooseberry pie Snow White bakes for Grumpy
Gooseberries cooked with sugar, baked in shortcrust with a pastry lid at 190C for 45 minutes, with cream.
K: Shiny red apple and cinnamon punch

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon and cloves, chilled and topped with sparkling apple, with thin red apple slices floating on top. Simmer 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 2 strips of orange peel for 10 minutes, then cool and chill for 2 hours. Strain into a jug. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml sparkling apple juice. Float thin slices of 1 red apple on top and serve in glasses with a cinnamon stick each.

s.note: the dwarfs digging diamonds in the mine
s.how: Cut 150g each of cheddar, gouda and brie into small cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with red and green grapes, alternating colours. Pile them high on a dark wooden board so they glitter like gems freshly dug from the mine, and serve at room temperature.

s.note: the forest animals that help Snow White clean the cottage
s.how: Toss 100g each of walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds with 3 tbsp honey, a spoon of chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely, then break into clusters for little hands.

m.note: supper for seven hungry dwarfs home from the mine
m.how: Soften 2 sliced leeks in butter, then add 500g diced chicken thighs, 600g diced potatoes, thyme and 1.5L water with salt. Simmer for 30 minutes until the potatoes break down. Stir in 150ml cream and serve in big bowls with torn crusty bread.

w.note: the gooseberry pie Snow White bakes for Grumpy
w.how: Cook 500g gooseberries with 150g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and cover with a pastry lid. Cut a few slits, brush with milk and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve warm with cream.

d.n: Shiny red apple and cinnamon punch

Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml sparkling apple juice. Float thin slices of 1 red apple on top and serve in glasses with a cinnamon stick each.
